name: Sorcerer Drake Tamer
body:
Rather than from a kinship with true dragons, a drake tamer derives her power from her affinity to drakes.

Bloodline: A drake tamer must belong to the draconic bloodline.

Drake Companion: A drake tamer gains a drake companion at 1st level, and her effective charge level for this ability is equal to her sorcerer level – 3 (minimum 1st).

This ability replaces bloodline arcana, the 1st—and 9th—level bloodline powers, and the 7th-, 13th-, and 19th-level bloodline feats.

Alternate Energies: The energy type of a drake tamer depends on the type of her drake companion:

Drake Type	Energy Type
Coral	Cold
Desert	Electricity
Elemental	Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire
Ether	Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire
Fire	Fire
Flame	Fire
Forest	Acid
Frost	Cold
Ice	Cold
Jungle	Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire
Lava	Fire
Mist	Cold
Rift	Acid
River	Acid
Salt	Acid
Sea	Electricity
Shadow	Cold
Spire	Cold
Star	Choose cold or fire
